brief_title: Comparison of Different Doses of Vitamin D Supplementation on Glycated Haemoglobin and Blood Glucose Parameters With Type II Diabetes Mellitus Having Vitamin d Deficiency
official_title: Comparison of Different Doses of Vitamin D Supplementation on Glycated Haemoglobin and Blood Glucose Parameters With Type II Diabetes Mellitus Having Vitamin d Deficiency
brief_summary: COMPARISON OF DIFFERENT DOSES OF VITAMIN D SUPPLEMENTATION ON GLYCATED HEMOGLOBIN (HbA1c) and BLOOD GLUCOSE PARAMETRS IN PATIENTS WITH TYPE 2 DIABETES MELLITUS HAVING VITAMIN D DEFICIENCY"

eligibility.criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

Patients diagnosed of T2DM with the age of 40-70 years from both genders taking only metformin with an Hb1Ac range of 7.5-9% and 25-hydroxy Vitamin D levels (25\[OH\]D) \<20ng/ml. Exclusion Criteria: Individuals

Exclusion Criteria: Individuals with the following conditions will not be included as participants;

* Inability or unwilling to participate or Clinical proximal myopathy
* Renal, hepatic, endocrinological disorders or malignancies on basis of history
* Serum calcium levels \> 10.5mg/dl
* Use of insulin or any change in dosage of current hypoglycemic medications during last 3 months
* Intake of vitamin D, calcium or omega 3 supplements within the past 3 months
